description: This file is a jQuery adapter for CKEditor, providing functions to initialize and interact with CKEditor instances within jQuery, including overriding the val() method for textareas with CKEditor instances.

methods.name: ckeditorGet
methods.description: Retrieves the CKEditor instance associated with the first element in the jQuery collection.

methods.name: ckeditor
methods.description: Initializes CKEditor on selected elements, either inline or replacing textareas, with support for callbacks and event handling.
